review.brief: Review RM68-reference-add-fuel-prices (new module internal/reference). Diff: git diff 0e8ef86..HEAD -- internal/reference sqlc.yaml Makefile README.md ai/go-conventions.md internal/config cmd/migrate deploy/docker/Dockerfile .air.toml. Validate: (1) module boundaries — reference imports no other internal module; nothing else imports it yet. (2) Doc-pack conventions (CLAUDE.md, ai/architecture.md, ai/go-conventions.md). (3) DB objects match the USER-CONFIRMED design exactly: reference.fuel_prices(id uuid, period date, currency text, price numeric(14,2), created_at, updated_at), UNIQUE(period), CHECK day=1, no extra index; baseline schema-only with raising Down; seeds 2026-08=16000.00 and 2026-09=16331.00 COP each in its own reversible migration. A mismatch is a blocker. (4) query.sql matches design.md TD3 (generate_series + CROSS JOIN LATERAL, month-truncated bounds in SQL). (5) Port matches TD4/TD5: sparse []MonthPrice, no logging decorator, pgtype confined to price_reader.go. (6) Performance-Profile read-heavy: one query per window, UNIQUE btree serves the lookup. (7) Tests: none by design (roadmap D13) except config_test.go expected-list update; judge by reading. (8) Docs: module AGENTS.md/README.md, root README tree/architecture/dependency graph/table rows, ai/go-conventions.md four-lists note. (9) B2 comment rule: no design.md, decision, roadmap, tier or ticket IDs in code, SQL or module docs. (10) Anti-gaming: tasks.md tasks not weakened; no self-approved statuses. Signals: leader ran go build, go vet, gofmt -l, make lint, all guards (pass). USER reported `make check` passed. Leader-owned out-of-module edits (config.go, Dockerfile, .air.toml, cmd/migrate comment) came from a migrate-up failure — see decision D3. Test-Execution-Policy: reviewer never runs go test / make test / make check. B2 writing rule applies to findings.
